text: The applicant was born in 1948.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant lives in Yerevan.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: In 2003 a presidential election was held in Armenia.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The first round of the 2003 Armenian presidential election took place on 19 February 2003.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The second round of the 2003 Armenian presidential election took place on 5 March 2003.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant acted as an authorised election assistant (վստահված անձ) for the main opposition candidate in the 2003 Armenian presidential election.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: Following the first and second rounds of the 2003 Armenian presidential election, a series of protest rallies were organised in Yerevan by the opposition parties.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: According to the materials of the case, the applicant attended one of the opposition protest rallies in Yerevan on 23 February 2003.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant denied attending the opposition protest rallies in Yerevan and alleged that he had not attended the rallies.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 26 February 2003 at 8 a.m. the applicant was visited at home by two police officers from the Shengavit District Police Department (ՀՀ ոստիկանության Շենգավիթի բաժին).
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The two police officers from the Shengavit District Police Department informed the applicant that the chief of the police department wished to speak to him.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant was taken to the Shengavit District Police Department police station on 26 February 2003.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: At the Shengavit District Police Department police station an administrative case was initiated against the applicant.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant was charged under Article 172 of the Code of Administrative Offences (Վարչական իրավախախտումների վերաբերյալ ՀՀ օրենսգիրք – the Code of Administrative Offences) with minor hooliganism.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The charge of minor hooliganism against the applicant was on the ground that he had participated in the unauthorised demonstration of 23 February 2003 and had violated public order.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 26 February 2003, several hours after being brought to the police station, the applicant was taken to the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan (Երևան քաղաքի Կենտրոն և Նորք-Մարաշ համայնքների առաջին ատյանի դատարան).
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: At the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan, the applicant was brought before Judge H.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: Judge H. conducted a brief hearing concerning the applicant's case.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: Judge H. found the applicant guilty as charged under Article 172 of the Code of Administrative Offences with minor hooliganism.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: Judge H. sentenced the applicant to ten days of administrative detention.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: Judge H. found that on 23 February 2003 on Mashtots Avenue in Yerevan the applicant participated together with a group of people in an unauthorised demonstration and march, and violated public order.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The decision of Judge H. of 26 February 2003 stated that it could be protested against by the prosecutor under Article 289 of the Code of Administrative Offences.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant was taken to a detention facility to serve his ten-day sentence of administrative detention.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant alleged that on 1 March 2003 he was taken from his cell to another room in the detention facility.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant alleged that on the table in the room there were two sample applications.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant alleged that one of the two sample applications was handed to him with the instruction to write and sign his name on it.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The content of the application handed to the applicant was a statement which declared: "I regret what I have done and request a review of my case."
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The application handed to the applicant was addressed to the President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal (ՀՀ քրեական և զինվորական գործերով վերաքննիչ դատարանի նախագահ).
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant alleged that he had to sign the application document even though he disagreed with its contents, in order to be released and to be able to perform his authorised election assistant duties in the second round of the 2003 Armenian presidential election.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 1 March 2003 the President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal reviewed the applicant's conviction.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal found, in reviewing the applicant's conviction, that the applicant had been subjected to administrative detention for attending an unauthorised demonstration in the Kentron District of Yerevan on 23 February 2003 and violating public order, according to the decision of the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal found, having reviewed the applicant's appeal and the materials concerning the administrative offence, that the penalty imposed on the applicant must be changed.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal changed the applicant's penalty from ten days of administrative detention to an administrative fine of 2,000 Armenian drams (AMD), which was approximately 3 euros (EUR) at the material time.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal ordered the applicant's release from detention.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On the evening of 1 March 2003 the applicant was released from detention.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: At the time of his release on 1 March 2003, the applicant had served approximately three days of his ten-day sentence of administrative detention.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 26 March 2003 the applicant sent an application to the Ministry of Justice (ՀՀ արդարադատության նախարարություն) arguing that he had never participated in any demonstrations, and in particular the one held on 23 February 2003, and seeking a review of his case.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 26 March 2003 the applicant sent an application to the Court of Cassation (ՀՀ վճռաբեկ դատարան) arguing that he had never participated in any demonstrations, and in particular the one held on 23 February 2003, and seeking a review of his case.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 26 March 2003 the applicant sent an application to the Presidential Human Rights Commission (ՀՀ նախագահին առընթեր մարդու իրավունքների հարցերի հանձնաժողով) arguing that he had never participated in any demonstrations, and in particular the one held on 23 February 2003, and seeking a review of his case.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: By a letter of 3 April 2003 the Court of Cassation forwarded the applicant's application to be dealt with by the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: By a letter of 11 April 2003 the Ministry of Justice informed the applicant that the rights of persons charged with an administrative offence were defined in Article 276 of the Code of Administrative Offences and should have been invoked by the applicant during the examination of his case.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The Ministry of Justice's letter of 11 April 2003 further stated that the decision of 26 February 2003 could be protested against by the prosecutor.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: By a letter of 16 April 2003 the President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal informed the applicant that his application of 26 March 2003 could not be examined, since the applicant had missed the prescribed 10-day time-limit for appeal.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: By a letter of 17 April 2003 the General Prosecutor's Office gave a reply to the applicant's application addressed to the Presidential Human Rights Commission similar to the reply given by the President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal on 16 April 2003.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 27 April 2003 the applicant again complained to the Ministry of Justice that the decision of 26 February 2003 had been unlawful since he had not participated in any demonstration.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: By a letter of 6 May 2003 the Ministry of Justice gave the same reply as its letter of 11 April 2003 in response to the applicant's complaint of 27 April 2003.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 10 June 2003 the Department for the Enforcement of Judicial Acts (Դատական ակտերի հարկադիր կատարման ծառայություն – the Department for the Enforcement of Judicial Acts) instituted enforcement proceedings.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The enforcement proceedings instituted by the Department for the Enforcement of Judicial Acts on 10 June 2003 were based on an execution writ issued by the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan on 15 May 2003.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant alleged that around the period of June 2003 he was visited at home by an officer of the Department for the Enforcement of Judicial Acts.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant alleged that the officer of the Department for the Enforcement of Judicial Acts informed him that the decision of 26 February 2003 had been reviewed on 1 March 2003 and a fine had been imposed.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant alleged that only upon the visit of the officer of the Department for the Enforcement of Judicial Acts did he become aware of the existence of the decision of the President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal of 1 March 2003.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant paid the administrative fine of 2,000 Armenian drams (AMD) imposed by the President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal on 1 March 2003.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 12 June 2003 the Department for the Enforcement of Judicial Acts decided to terminate the enforcement proceedings since the terms of the execution writ had been complied with.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: A summary of the relevant domestic provisions and international documents and reports is contained in the judgment in the case of Galstyan v. Armenia (no. 26986/03, §§ 25-32, 15 November 2007).
